title: docs(adr-0061): record that field-level searchable is honoured on the auto branch (D2 says it stays pruned; ruling 6573569376 letter A reversed it in #29008)
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmSduNGC2SZXszyrNut

Filing gate: ② a governed follow-up owed by PR #29385 (#29008), named by its `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review (seat record on the PR, ③ Q1). `docs/adr/**` is Tier H and outside that card's claim, so the PR does not carry it. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

## What is false after #29385 lands

`docs/adr/0061-record-search-architecture.md` D2 says "Field-level `searchable` stays pruned", and the "Default behaviour (normative)" row reads `$searchFields` (validated) → view → `object.searchableFields` → auto (name + short-text). Ruling record 6573569376 (letter A, the maintainer's 「同意」 2026-11-02T09:22Z) reverses the first and widens the second. Prime Directive 13 wants the reversal recorded on the ADR.

## Wanted

An amendment note directly under the D2 bullet (the amended sentence itself is not rewritten). Draft by the #29008 dev: `/mnt/project-files/spec-seat2/29008-adr-0061-note.md`. Its core:

> **Amendment note (2026-11-02, #29008, ruling record 6573569376, letter A).** Field-level `searchable` is no longer pruned: it is honoured on the auto branch. With no `object.searchableFields` declared, the resolved set is the type-based auto-default plus every field marked `searchable: true`, of any type except `secret` / `password` / `vector` (`SEARCH_FLAG_EXCLUDED_TYPES`) and a virtual field. A declared `searchableFields` stays the whole set and the flag is not read there. The `$searchFields` ingress allow-list is the same resolution, so a flagged field is accepted as an override.

Also re-read D5 ("secret / encrypted / PII never searchable") in the same note: the hard exclusions are what keep D5 true under the flag; say so if it holds. Header: an `**Amended by**:` entry (ADR-0005 is the precedent shape); not on the `**Status**:` line.

Blocked-by: #29008 (PR #29385)

Reader who acts: an ADR-governed docs PR (GOVERNED_APPROVERS before landing).

Dedupe: searched `ADR-0061 searchable amendment`: only #29008 itself. **New.**
